title: A Short Visit and a Weekend Plan
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟练习（非官方雅思测试）。先听/读对话，注意 was/were、常用过去式和 be going to 的用法。然后完成8道听力题和8道语法题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo. Was your grandma at home yesterday?
Leo: Yes, she was. I was at her house. We were there for two hours.
Mia: Nice. Was your sister with you?
Leo: No, she wasn't. She was at work. My grandma was happy.
Mia: What did you do?
Leo: We talked and we ate cake. Then I walked home. It was cold.
Mia: Are you going to visit her again?
Leo: Yes, I am. I'm going to go on Sunday because it's her birthday.
Mia: Great. Are you going to buy a gift?
Leo: No, I'm not. I'm going to make a card. She likes cards.

questions.explanation: 原文 Leo 说 “I was at her house.”，her 指 grandma，所以昨天他在奶奶家。
Mia 问 “Was your sister with you?”，Leo 回答 “No, she wasn't.”，说明妹妹不在。

questions.prompt: How long were they there? ______ hours.
questions.explanation: Leo 说 “We were there for two hours.”，所以填 two。
questions.evidence: We were there for two hours.

questions.prompt: What did Leo and his grandma do?
questions.explanation: Leo 说 “We talked and we ate cake.”，他们聊天并吃了蛋糕。
questions.evidence: We talked and we ate cake.

questions.explanation: 原文说 “Then I walked home.”，他是走回家的。

questions.prompt: When is Leo going to visit his grandma?
questions.explanation: Leo 说 “I'm going to go on Sunday because it's her birthday.”，计划是周日去。
questions.evidence: I'm going to go on Sunday because it's her birthday.

questions.prompt: Is Leo going to buy a gift?
questions.explanation: Mia 问 “Are you going to buy a gift?”，Leo 回答 “No, I'm not.”，他不打算买礼物。

questions.prompt: What is Leo going to make? A ______.
questions.explanation: Leo 说 “I'm going to make a card.”，他打算做一张卡片。
questions.evidence: I'm going to make a card.

vocabulary.example: Was your grandma at home yesterday?
We were there for two hours.
We talked and we ate cake.
I'm going to go on Sunday because it's her birthday.

grammar.title: was / were、常用过去式与 be going to
grammar.explanation: was/were 是 am/is/are 的过去式：I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。否定：was not = wasn't，were not = weren't。常用过去式表示过去做的事，如 talked, walked, ate。be going to 表示计划：I am going to + 动词原形；否定 I'm not going to + 动词原形；疑问 Are you going to + 动词原形？because 表示原因。
grammar.example: I was at her house. We were there for two hours. I'm going to make a card.

questions.explanation: 主语 I 的过去式用 was。

questions.prompt: They ______ at the park last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 的过去式用 were。
questions.evidence: We were there for two hours.

questions.explanation: 主语 She 的否定过去式用 wasn't。
last night 表示过去，动词用过去式 watched。
questions.evidence: We talked and we ate cake.

questions.explanation: tomorrow 表示计划，用 be going to；主语 I 用 am going to。
questions.evidence: I'm going to go on Sunday because it's her birthday.

questions.prompt: ______ you going to buy a gift?
questions.explanation: 主语 you 的 be going to 疑问句用 Are you going to...?
questions.evidence: Are you going to buy a gift?

questions.prompt: He is going to study ______ he has a test.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因：他学习是因为有考试。
questions.evidence: I'm going to go on Sunday because it's her birthday.

questions.prompt: They ______ going to come to the party.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 的 be going to 否定用 aren't going to。
